title: Keep the fixed-disorder residual and defeated first fixture
statement: The separate acquired approximate-permutation construction retains observed tags,reads full rational input and certifies the ACTUAL fixed-disorder realization through full primal/dual residuals,including row sums/cross-correlations. Prototype supports one acquired bath class and refuses unsupported counts. Reported13spin case has reference dimension1820,residual contraction168960,full operator space67108864,and qualified complex output radius. General solve remainsO(M³). Small relative disorder need not preserve a narrow line:at eta=gamma1/1024,delta=gamma,J1/4,a .39%relative perturbation changes the central-line contribution80%. The initial256spin fixture lost to global-H trial. Established variational,Green-Kubo,memory-matrix,tensor and permutation methods receive these constructions too;no runtime victory established. Full conditional-bath leakage may cost eta^-4;unstructured weak-noise local prediction remains open.
